errors.text_span: според паричната оценка по паричната единица на страната (ППС)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly explains the acronym ППС (PPS - Purchasing Power Standard) as "monetary valuation according to the country's monetary unit". The correct meaning is "Purchasing Power Standard" (Стандарт на покупателна способност), which is an artificial currency unit used for international comparisons, not the national currency of Latvia.
